apps.name: AirCard-iOS
apps.subtitle: Apple Wallet 卡片与锁屏主题
apps.localizedDescription:
Apple Wallet 卡片样式与锁屏密码主题工具。

开源协议：MIT · 项目主页：https://github.com/Mak5er/AirCard-iOS
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed in v1.3.2 🚀

This update brings full feature parity with AirCard macOS v1.2.6, restores robust card discovery across all iOS versions, introduces automatic bank/network recognition with custom card nicknames, delivers an ultra-fast tunnel cache (0.02s connections), and completely resolves wallpaper flashing for Collections and Mercury wallpapers.

### 💳 Wallet Card Discovery & Bank Identification
• **Universal Wallet Log Parser**: Ported the proven `WalletScanParser` from AirCard macOS. Captures cards from `Dashboard loading (...): for SOO+`, `passIDs[InSession]`, `passIDs[global]`, and modern JSON NFC activations (`"identifier": "HEX"`).
• **Automatic Bank & Network Detection**: Recognizes Visa, Mastercard, American Express, UnionPay, Discover, and JCB via applet AIDs during selection.
• **Card Nicknames (Rename)**: Added a direct **Rename** button (✏️) so you can give your cards friendly names like *"Monobank"*, *"Salary Card"*, or *"Revolut"*, safely persisted in app settings.
• **28-Character Fallback Token Matcher**: Restores dependable card discovery on devices where standard log patterns are redacted.

### ⚡ Ultra-Fast Tunnel Routing (from 10s to 0.02s!)
• **Working Route Caching**: `rust-core` now caches the active RSD connection route (`LAST_WORKING_ROUTE`), eliminating repeated port and interface scanning.
• **RSD-First Priority**: Connects directly via RemoteXPC on port 49152, bypassing slow Lockdown retries and broken pipes on iOS 18+.
• **Eliminated Loopback Policy Drops**: Removed local loopback attempts that caused `policy drop` control channel errors.

### 🖼 Wallpapers (.tendies) — Collections & Mercury Fixes
• **Dual Injection on iOS 18+**: Wallpapers are now injected into both their primary bundle (`com.apple.WallpaperKit.CollectionsPoster` or `com.apple.MercuryPoster`) and the modern iOS 18+ application container (`com.apple.Posters.CollectionsPosterApp` / `com.apple.Posters.MercuryPosterApp`).
• **Metadata Synchronization**: Fix

apps.name: GestaltX
apps.subtitle: MobileGestalt 编辑器
apps.localizedDescription:
MobileGestalt 编辑器，可调整区域码、设备预设、备份配置。需要 iOS 26.0 及以上；安装包来自上游 GitHub Release。

开源协议：GPL-3.0 · 项目主页：https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX
apps.versionDescription:
English | [简体中文](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX/blob/main/CHANGELOG_ZH-CN.md)

Build `11140102`.

### Added

- App Audio Library: replace notification sounds with custom audio. Apps not shown in the list can use the capture guide to obtain their notification-sound paths.
- Pairing & Device Connection: used to obtain required paths.

### Changed

- Case-insensitive cache UUID comparison (#131)
- Reject trailing text in date fields (#132)
- Share-inbox fallback (#133)
- Validate backup metadata filenames (#134)
- Reduce cache descriptor string-scan allocations (#135)
- Reuse one preview snapshot for field search (#136)
- Preserve field edits over layout presets (#137)
- Preserve existing plist keys when editing fields (#138)
- Reduce allocations in exact plist comparisons (#139)
- Traverse document differences once (#140)
- Fix Face ID failing after enabling Apple Intelligence (#128)
- Add missing localization for #128 (#146)
- Pairing paths are migrated when a reinstall moves the app data container.

### Fixed

- Fix pairing failure in side-loaded release builds.
- Add the missing Face ID recovery localization strings.
- Fix audio file selection in side-loaded builds.
- Refresh captured sounds immediately and cache the app audio list.
- Show LocalDevVPN guidance and stop capture when the tunnel does not connect.

apps.name: iPadn
apps.subtitle: 下载安装你拥有的 App
apps.localizedDescription:
在 iPhone 和 iPad 上搜索、下载、安装你拥有的 App：历史版本、已下架应用、多地区比价与原生安装。安装包未签名，请用自己的工具签名后安装。

项目主页：https://github.com/mengangs/ipadn
apps.versionDescription:
## iPadn 2.1.3

本次为修复与体验优化更新，解决关键词搜索时的并发闪退问题，隔离顶部提示动画重绘，并改进 iOS 27 本机配对引导与灵动岛交接体验。安装包未签名，请用自己的工具签名后安装。

### 修复与优化

- **修复关键词搜索闪退与并发竞争**：移除搜索前并发嵌套任务组与超时竞争探测，改为在搜索结果返回后按商店地区顺序核验候选已下架应用（最多 15 项），并在新搜索、取消搜索或关闭开关时显式取消旧核验任务。
- **隔离全局提示动画并优化切换账号响应**：将顶部提示与撤销横幅拆分为独立视图，避免横幅弹簧动画触发整个标签页层级重绘；切换账号时先让提示横幅开始渲染，再触发地区同步、重新搜索与已购刷新。
- **优化 iOS 27 本机配对引导与灵动岛提醒**：点按「打开设置」跳转到系统设置时主动释放后台音频并推送第 1 步灵动岛横幅指引，补充锁屏密码验证提示与 11 种语言文案，后台等待状态更新支持按代数及时取消，避免旧状态阻塞新提醒。
- 继续支持 iOS / iPadOS 16 及更新版本，各功能保留各自系统版本要求。

### 两个安装包

- `iPadn-2.1.3-unsigned.ipa`：标准版，含实时活动和小组件，签名需要 2 个 App ID。
- `iPadn-2.1.3-lite-unsigned.ipa`：精简版，不含扩展，只需 1 个 App ID；不提供实时活动或小组件，其他功能相同。
- SideStore、AltStore、Feather 等签名工具可添加源：`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mengangs/ipadn/main/altstore-source.json`。

### English

This maintenance release fixes a concurrency crash during keyword search, isolates top notice banner animations, and polishes iOS 27 on-device pairing guidance and Live Activity handoff.

- **Fix keyword-search crash & concurrency race**: Remove nested concurrent task-group pre-probes during keyword search; verify up to 15 candidate delisted apps sequentially after search results arrive and cancel stale verification tasks on new searches, cancellation or setting toggles.
- **Isolate notice overlay & smooth account switching**: Extract the top notice/undo banner into its own view so notice spring animations do not re-evaluate the entire tab hierarchy, and let the switched-account banner begin rendering before triggering region sync, search and purchase refresh.
- **Polish iOS 27 on-device pairing & Live Activity handoff**: Pause background keep-alive and push a Step 1 Dynamic Island guidance banner when opening Settings, clarify `< Settings` navigation and passcode-prompt instructions across all 11 languages, and cancel superseded Live Activity background waits promptly.
- iOS / iPadOS 16 and later remain supported, subject to each feature's requirements.

Both packages are unsigned: the standard package includes Live Act

apps.name: WQ Files
apps.subtitle: 文件浏览器与缓存清理
apps.localizedDescription:
iOS 26/27 的文件浏览器、应用数据管理与缓存清理，无需越狱。需要 iOS 27 或 iOS 26.0–26.7.2；签名时须保留 App Group 权限。

项目主页：https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles
apps.versionDescription:
> **Requires:** iOS 27, or iOS 26.0 – 26.7.2. Tested on iOS 27.0.1, 27.2.1, 26.7.1 and the 27.3 beta (confirmed by a user); see [Tested devices](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#tested-devices).
> **Needs:** a sideloading tool that keeps the App Group entitlement; see [Signing](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#signing-the-app-group) in the README.

# Worse Query Files 0.9.11

## New

- **Vietnamese** ([#62](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/pull/62)): WQ Files is now available in Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt). Pick it in **Settings → Language**.
- **Scans keep running and survive restarts** ([#61](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/pull/61)): Apps and Clean keep scanning when you switch tabs, and the last result is kept when WQ Files closes. An interrupted scan continues where it stopped. Use **Pause Scan** / **Resume Scan** to pause or resume one. A result older than 10 minutes refreshes when you open the screen.
- **Scan status in the tab bar:** a tab shows a spinner while its scan runs and a clock ◷ while it waits for another scan. On iPhone this is a gray badge.

## Changed

- **Full file scans ask before resuming:** an interrupted full scan only continues after you confirm it, and **Stop** discards its saved progress.
- **Fewer disk writes:** scan progress is saved every 20 seconds, without holding up the scan. Saved progress is deleted when a scan finishes, or after a week if it isn't resumed.

## Credit

New design: GpGp700. Sandbox technique: [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query) by Taj C (forcequit). Container enumeration: [KAMUI](https://github.com/murk-sus/kamui-escape) by murk-sus. Resumable scans: hhh2210. Translations: iosrxwy (Simplified Chinese), hfip (Arabic), hooray804 (Korean), Reinascape (Russian), romlayvn-93 (Vietnamese), buraakkcayir (Turkish review). Thanks to everyone who sent Logs and screenshots. GPL-3.0-or-later.

SHA-256 of WQFiles.ipa: `b0ca5602762263b9db088f9df8536245fe178645aeb24587b8a2f818c9e996b8`

An interrupted scan continues where it stopped. Use **Pause Scan** / **Resume Scan** to pause or resume one. A result older than 10 minutes refreshes when you open the screen.
- **Scan status in the tab bar:** a tab shows a spinner while its scan runs and a clock ◷ while it waits for another scan. On iPhone this is a gray badge.

## Changed

- **Full file scans ask before resuming:** an interrupted full scan only continues after you confirm it, and **Stop** discards its saved progress.
- **Fewer disk writes:** scan progress is saved every 20 seconds, without holding up the scan. Saved progress is deleted when a scan finishes, or after a week if it isn't resumed.
